purpose: Offline editorial relevance checks on the fixed 80-game catalog. Authored before running rankings; not real user judgments or a held-out research benchmark.

scenarios.brief: No recorded taste: show general picks without claiming personal evidence.
Relaxed games with cozy presentation; avoid horror and difficult action.
Puzzle solving without horror; allow exploration and cooperative puzzles.
Cooperative play without horror; no requirement that a game also carry the Multiplayer tag.
Return to two saved intentions before exploring more roguelikes; never suggest the current or disliked game.
Liked and finished Celeste; look for precise movement, discovery or strong narrative. This editorial set is intentionally broader than one tag.
Space exploration, with no multiplayer games in this session.
A market-comparison collection must not become personal interest evidence.
One personal collection containing Celeste supplies interest evidence once.
Saving the same game in three personal folders must not increase its influence.
A wishlisted horror game is excluded after the player opts out of horror.
